title: SBIL (Saylani School of Business and Islamic Leadership), Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: SBIL (Saylani School of Business and Islamic Leadership), located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: Gulshan Chowrangi, Mumtaz Mobile Mall. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=24.9258152,67.0075394. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Karachi as the city.
